## 2026-11-16 slice 12: one source of Romanian -> English words; the sense chosen by the reading (reviewer 03:30 items 1-3)
- **One lookup** (`src/translate/lexicon-ro.mjs` `lookupRo` / `sensesRo`, spec 05 "One lookup of the source words"): the rules translator, the gloss (`glossWord`) and the candidates ask one lookup in the order (1) the open world instance's words (`prefer` = `worldWords` of the open world instance, passed by the door), (2) the translator's entries (lexicon.ro-en.mjs), (3) the dictionary (w.lang.ro: catalog rows, then local rows; `ro.sensesOfLemma` gives every row of a lemma). Each analysed form has its sense list; a form read as two lemmas ("fata": fată girl / față face) has both.
- **No leftover**: ro-en.mjs translates in two passes: the forms its first pass leaves as typed (`unknown`, 3 letters or more, read by the dictionary as a content word) are read by the dictionary's morphology in the translator's shape in a second pass ("desenează o vilă" -> "Draw a villa", "pe leagan" -> "on the swing", "pamint" -> "the ground", "ai exagerat" -> "You have exaggerated"). A word the translator handles by itself ("a", "numit") never gets a dictionary reading; a participle only the dictionary knows reads as an adjective of its English past participle.
- **Sense by the reading**: the translator reports forms with several senses (`senses`) and translates again with a chosen sense (`translate(text, { senses })`); `gatherCandidates` adds up to 3 `rules-sense` candidates (one form at a time, after the rest of the rules chain). The door keeps the one `readRequest` reads best; a tie keeps the earlier one, except that a sense that is a word of the open world instance wins a tie against the translator's sense (`worldSense` in `_doorEnglish`). The translator's own reading stays the default (putting the world's sense first by default changed "a" / "formele" readings: measured and dropped).
- **Guard**: the gloss's dictionary typo repair stands only within `DICTIONARY_MAX_COST` 0.6 of the library's `editCost` (the contextual repair's bound for a dictionary-only word): "punr" -> pune, "iraba" -> iarbă (swap 0.6); "azuriu" -> auriu (golden) and "leagă" -> leagăn (swing) are gone: both stay unread (owner session 33, variant F2: "Nu am înțeles „azuriu”", "leagă" unread). [LIB] note: `editCost(a, b, max)` prunes rows before a swap is counted (`editCost('iraba','iarba',0.6)` = Infinity, with max 1 it is 0.6), so the host passes 1 and compares.

## 2026-11-16 slice 13 (4/5): "scrie o scrisoare scurta despre o vila" traced by hand; the mechanism fixed generically
- **The trace** (reviewer 05:05): (1) cleaner / diacritics: nothing to repair; the diacritic-free forms are read (`scurta` -> scurtă, `vila` -> vilă: the repaired-rules candidate has "scurtă"). (2) the one lookup knows every content word: gloss scrie -> write, scrisoare -> letter, scurta -> short, vila -> villa ("o", "despre" are function words the translator handles itself). (3) **the rules translator**: the phrase frame `scrie {rest:raw}` -> `type {rest:raw}` (src/translate/phrases.commands.ro-en.mjs: dictation, the rest kept as typed) matched before any word was read, so the English was "Type o scrisoare scurta despre o vila"; the kinds of text it knows have their own frames above it (poveste, eseu, raport), "scrisoare" has none. (4) the candidates: rules and repaired-rules both went through the same frame (8 unread words each). (5) the reading: "type" = make (docs.editor core.word), every other word unread. So even "o" and "despre" were unread because the dictation frame kept them in Romanian: a mechanism, not vocabulary.
- **The fix** (generic, spec 05 "A dictation frame is one reading"): the translator reports a frame with a `raw` slot (`verbatim: true`) and translates without such frames on request (`verbatim: false`); `gatherCandidates` adds that translation as `rules-plain` right after `rules`; the door's reading chooses (fewest unread words; a tie keeps the dictation). ### 3. Ranked removal plan (first = safest, nothing on the owner sessions changes)

Each step is verified by the same three-session replay (right / honest / wrong per session: 14/26/3, 12/3/1, 26/22/3 and false-done 0) plus `npm run test:smoke`; the real set and test-world are reported, not gates (AGENTS: "Old tests as gates"). Steps marked (X) change what the Map / Charts / Music / Draw cross-tab probes answer (cross-domain routing first).

1. **Dead weight with no reader**: `*/coverage.md` (8 generated reports), 13 `datagen.mjs` only if the owner agrees training generators are retired (otherwise leave; export-training reads them). Effect on owner rows: none. Tags: DEL.
2. **Imports and reads of retired worlds from the door-covered worlds**: drop `imports=world.kids.*` from art.draw, docs.editor (kids.common, kids.tasks, kids.arith), data.charts' kids.arith / shop / tasks (with `buildHoldings`, `buildPrices`, `buildList`: never ran), docs.editor `editor.mjs` kids reads (`_holdings` and the list reader). `talk` peeks other worlds' state and imports art.draw's generated catalog: cut. Effect on owner rows: none (no owner row reached them). Tags: DEL, A.
3. **The old planner and the old word operations of the door worlds, not the hooks**: art.draw/plan.mjs `runPlan` and the planner half (60% of the file never ran), engine.mjs operations, diagram.sketch/engine.mjs operations, docs.editor/editor.mjs (73% never ran), facelogic word operations (after the popup flag is ON). Also stops the rolled-back read from running them. Effect: none on declared tabs; (X) only for the cross-tab draw / diagram / write route. Tags: DEL, B.
4. **Declarations that shadow the catalog in request.sop** (no code removed, only rows; fixes real bugs): docs.editor story / essay / report / poem kinds + 9 expectation rows (the genre shadow bug of the 0.167 note); art.draw 20 per-kind `@t` / `@k` rows, the ~25 `of=` and 24 `accepts=` values, 7 `drawn` rows, 3 region rows, 10 enums (size, place, layout); diagram.sketch colour / shape / size enums (30 enums, 36 accepts) and 10 `std.tool.value` rows; ui.avatar 4 `drawn` rows + 4 value rows (rename the tool's slots to the catalog's). Expected: inventory numbers fall (drawn 12 -> 0, kinds declared 46 -> about 8). Risk: each step moves a kind from the board's own to the join; replay the owner sessions per file, in this order: docs.editor, ui.avatar, diagram.sketch, art.draw. Tags: E, F, C, D, K.
5. **Tool JS holding words or kinds** (spec 28 section 14): board.mjs sun / moon / rainbow positions, `GROUND_COLOR`, `lake` / `pond` / `sea` literals, `common.sense.*` ids, the default colours in scene.mjs BUILTIN; diagram core.mjs `TAB`. Needs declared `needs` / `makes` preconditions and k.layouts anchors, i.e. a little new declaration work, hence after 4. Tags: B, D, E, F.
6. **Generated copies of the catalog**: art.draw/things.catalog.mjs (55 KB, loaded 100%, also read by talk), ui.avatar/default-face.mjs, diagram engine/templates.mjs (check against k.diagrams).
